author: Ms Sarah Welch
description: This folio leaf is from a 12th-century Advaita commentary on the Nārāyaṇa Upaniṣad. It is attributed to Vijñānātman. The text is mostly in Malayalam script, but later leaves have Grantha script, likely because there was an ongoing collaboration after the 12th-century between Tamil scholars fluent in Grantha script and the Kerala monastery fluent in Malayalam script. A digital version of this text has been archived by the British Library with the assistance of École française d’Extrême-Orient. The original is preserved in Kerala, at Vadakke Madham Brahmaswam – a Vedic studies center. This is a photo of a 2-D manuscript artwork originally copied between 1700-1850 CE, of a 12th century text. Therefore Wikimedia Commons PD-Art licensing guidelines apply. Any rights I have as a photographer is herewith donated to wikimedia commons under CC0 license.
title: File:12th century bhasya on Narayana Upanishad, Sanskrit manuscript in Thrissur Hindu monastery, Malayalam script - 1.jpg
